frontmatter.name: tsheen-chief-of-staff
frontmatter.description: Project chief-of-staff: manager plans, applicable specialists implement, verification runs after dependencies converge, then review and bounded remediation. Prefer this over the global skill when present.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-test
frontmatter.description: Runs the chief verification stage with the exact code-testing-agent pipeline: size the scope, pick Direct / Single pass / Iterative, run Research → Plan → Implement when broad, then mandatory final build, final test, coverage-gap iteration and the pre-completion gate (test-gap-analysis + assertion-quality + requirement coverage). Returns a Requirement | Evidence handoff to the chief.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-task-memory
frontmatter.description: Shared task ledger contract for chief subagents: what to read, the handoff to return, and how to report evidence. Run-state rules live in the chief skill.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-manager
frontmatter.description: Read-only manager that turns a chief request into a concrete plan in shared task memory. Does not edit application source.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-figma-ui
frontmatter.description: Tsheen UI standard from figma/tsheen.fig through the project MCP. Agents must load this skill before UI work in apps/react or any Figma-derived interface.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-backend
frontmatter.description: Implements assigned backend/API/domain work, reads the chief task ledger, and returns an evidence-based handoff without editing run state.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-frontend
frontmatter.description: Implements assigned UI work from the chief task ledger and dependency handoffs, then returns evidence without editing backend source or run state.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-code-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Read-only review of the current chief task against requirements, boundaries, verification, and maintainability. Security blockers belong to tsheen-security when Stage 5a ran; otherwise note obvious security issues. Returns a verdict without editing run state.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-security
frontmatter.description: Read-only defensive security review of the current chief task diff. Loads security-review and returns a verdict without editing run state.

frontmatter.name: tsheen-variants
frontmatter.description: Compares isolated implementations of one assigned work item, picks a base, and returns a synthesis brief. Loads variants and does not edit the primary tree or run state.
